name: Assured Assessment Design
description: An adaptation of the Claude skill for educators designing assured assessment. Consults on your situation, checks current guidance and develops inclusive supervised or interactive options, with assurance ratings, staffing maths and a practical plan.
conversation_starters: Help me redesign a take-home assessment while keeping an in-person endpoint.
My students use an IT lab without locked-down computers. How can I assure their learning?
I have a large cohort and limited staff time. Help me find workable assessment options.
Quick mode: help me choose three assessment formats for my cohort, learning outcomes and available rooms.
